decisions.decision: Re-scope Phase 3 from 'Slice 0 vertical slice' to 'Design System & Testing Infrastructure'

Pushing them in front of Slice 0 means every later phase ships against a real test suite and a real visual contract.

decisions.decision: Use Microsoft.Extensions.ApiDescription.Server for build-time OpenAPI codegen, output next to the .csproj as openapi-v1.json
decisions.rationale: User-suggested per Microsoft docs. .json extension issue: --file-name takes base name WITHOUT the .json suffix (regex [A-Za-z0-9_-]+ rejects dots). Live in source dir, gitignored, regenerated by every `dotnet build`. Single source of truth for FE + any future SDK.

9.x packages fail on net10.0 — the 9.x ApiDescription.Server ships GetDocument.Insider.dll only for net9.0; 9.x OpenApi causes GetDocumentCommandWorker..cctor to fail on assembly resolve under net10.0 runtime. Pinned to 10.0.0.
